notes.title: Taco Truck Madness goes LIVE on Steam!!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/932300/Taco_Truck_Madness/]Taco Truck Madness[/url] is Now Available on Steam!

And for a short time it includes a 20% launch discount.

Thanks for the community support and to everyone who has waited so patiently for us to release on Steam.
